actions.text: Path: Uncle Roe in Canterbury Commons hires the player to stop the two costumed rivals (stage 20, which enables both); the AntAgonizer is killed in her lair (90) and the Mechanist in his Forge (95), so both are dealt with (120); Roe pays the bonus (200, Complete Quest).

Starts with the player out of Vault 101 (the given): Escape! (CG04) done at stage 200, whose script starts Following in His Footsteps (MQ01 stage 10) and Trouble on the Homefront (MS16). [observed: CG04 stage 200 script]
Stand-in for the walk to Canterbury Commons: the player at Uncle Roe.

actions.label: roe: I might be able to help

actions.text: Stand-in for the way through the Canterbury tunnels into the AntAgonizer's Lair; she and her ants attack the costumed intruder and she is killed (the pilot fights). Her OnDeath sets stage 90 (one super dealt with: 100).
Stand-in for the way to the Mechanist's Forge (the elevator from the Robot Repair Center); the Mechanist is killed (the pilot fights). His OnDeath sets 95, and with 90 done, 120.
The Forge's elevator to Forge03 (ElevatorForge01to03REF) is locked at level 75 with no key; a player picks it (the pilot does not pick locks): a stand-in unlock.
Back to Uncle Roe for the reward.

actions.label: roe: just wandering through (his trader greeting)
roe: I took care of both
